items.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: he’s usually had Norman Simmons playing for him

ctx.x: Have you had occasion to perform with Joe Williams?

Well, on the same stage. I haven’t—because he’s usually had Norman Simmons playing for him, even if I’m the studio pianist in the orchestra, you know, he’s got his own piano player. But I’ve known Joe all these years, and always been a fan of his.
How do you feel his voice is, typifies jazz vocals?
